correctness.rationale: The frozen claim for every nontrivial ring character is false. For psi(x)=exp(2 pi i x/5) on Z/25 the moment is 69, not 89/25. The replacement distinguishes primitive from imprimitive characters: in the expanded fourth moment the two frequency sums detect j times the differences for a character of index j. A unit j detects the ring equalities, while an index of valuation one detects only the field equalities; each field quadruple has p^4 ring lifts. The representation spectrum and ring energy survive unchanged. With d=a-b, the unit-s equation is z^4+6z^2+1=lambda. A regular root has one lift for each target lift. At 1 the p lifts of z=0 contribute only to the exact target 1, alongside regular roots z^2=-6; at -8 the identity g+8=(z^2+3)^2 gives all p lifts per exceptional root only at -8. In the field, g(z)=g(w) describes the union z^2=w^2 and z^2+w^2=-6; their counts are 2p-1 and p-chi(-1) and the intersection size is 2u. The first and second fiber moments then solve for L,H after removing the two exceptional residue values. When p divides s, 8y=d^4, giving the stated h-to-one nonzero lifted fibers and p roots at zero. For the energy, the equality product (d^2-f^2)(d^2+f^2+6s^2) has E_p=3p^2-3p+1-2(p-1)c reduction zeros and S=p+2(p-1)u singular reduction zeros. The latter are the line d=f=0 and common zeros away from that line. At these, the product is zero for every lift, whereas a regular zero has p^2 lifts. This gives p^2 E_p+(p^3-p^2)S and the stated energy. The repair includes exact bounded per-sum comparisons and the field counts, separately from the universal proof.
residual_risks: The uploaded reference checker compares aggregate histograms and energy, not the locations of exceptional fibers or character orthogonality; the latter follow from the proof.
Scope remains p>=5 and modulus p^2, with counting measure on frequency space.

originality.rationale: The supported increment in the repair is the full ordered fiber classification over Z/p^2, including the descriptions of exceptional lifts and nonunit sums. The field energy, elementary character orthogonality and character-conductor correction are not counted as novel. The strongest same-object match gives energy, but explicitly omits individual fibers and has a later catalogued date.

value.rationale: The higher-multiplicity prime-square fibers are a substantive obstruction to transferring field convolution estimates. This gives all multiplicities, including targets missed entirely, concentrated critical lifts of size proportional to p, and a different nonunit-sum stratum. The exact classification is therefore useful even apart from the energy and supplies a benchmark for extension moments and lifting questions. The conductor correction alone is elementary and would not justify acceptance.
residual_risks: No conclusion about the optimal extension norm for arbitrary weights or a full spectrum at higher prime powers.
